title: Personal Trainer
description:
We are hiring a highly motivated Personal Trainer. Key Responsibilities:
- Conduct fitness consultations and assessments for clients.
- Design customized workout plans based on individual goals and fitness levels.
- Demonstrate proper exercise techniques and ensure client safety.
- Motivate and support clients in achieving their health objectives.
Requirements:
- Certified Personal Trainer (CPT) credential from a recognized organization (e.g., NASM, ACE).
- CPR and AED certification.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Passion for fitness and helping others.
